title: GO FISH KAUAI Sport Fishing Charters
specs: Fish for game fish like Marlin and Tuna
Boat: 41' Bertram Sport Fishing Yacht named Emma Nalani
You must be able to walk and stand on your own to safely enjoy your trip.
One Fish up to 50 lbs. may be cut, packaged and shared among the guests on board to enjoy a couple meals while here on island .
With other charter companies having an average 25lb policy, we are one of the most generous companies on the island when it comes to sharing our catch for you to enjoy on vacation.
1-Day License – $20, 7-Day License – $40, Annual License – $70 (not included in charter price)
No stated age or weight limits
Shared charters have a maximum of 6 people per trip
Private charters accommodate up to 6 people

blurb: Go Fish Kauai offers shared and private deep sea sport fishing charters departing daily from Nawiliwili Small Boat Harbor in Lihue, Kauai. Guests fish for game fish like Marlin and Tuna aboard a 41' Bertram Sport Fishing Yacht. Charters are available in durations of four, six, and eight hours.
extraNote: If you give us notice more than 5 days before your scheduled trip, there is no charge for canceling. if you are a no show or cancel within 5 days of your trip, it is a full charge. · In the event your Captain cancels the trip due to weather issues, there is no cancellation charge. · Important: The DLNR does not offer refunds for canceled trips, so we strongly recommend you wait to purchase your license on the day of your charter in case of weather or scheduling changes. · Do I tip the Captain and Crew? · How much should you tip is up to you. · What if I have physical restrictions & limitations?
